run_text_generation: run conditional text generation with an auto-regressive model using the run_generation CLI script
generate_past_key_values: generate past key-value tensors for a causal language model given batch size and sequence length
prepare_jit_inputs: prepare model inputs for JIT tracing including attention mask concatenation and past key values
adjust_length_to_model: adjust generation length to fit within the model's maximum sequence length
sparse_model_config: extract model configuration details including number of layers, attention heads, and embedding size per head
